name: 2 · Taking ground
author: OpenTactics
description: Capture property to earn money and win.

mission.briefing: Take the enemy headquarters on the far side. Cities on the way pay 1000 a day each.

hints.text: Infantry and mechs capture. Move onto a city and choose Capture.
A capture takes 20 points; a unit adds its health (up to 10) each turn, so two turns at full health.
If the capturing unit moves away or is hurt, progress is lost or slower.
Capturing the enemy headquarters wins at once.
